title: 梨園未散
subject: an opera troupe after the audience leaves
caption: Chinese guofeng orchestral pop. Guzheng arpeggios open alone, erhu carries the countermelody, dizi answers, a Chinese percussion section — bangu and cymbals — marks the chorus, all over a modern string arrangement. A bright female soprano sings forward-placed with xiqiang opera ornamentation, sliding into notes and running melismas at the ends of phrases. Studio-polished, wide stereo image, long reverb tails on the erhu. 76 BPM, A minor pentatonic. Elegant, faded grandeur.
lyrics:
[Intro - Guzheng]

[Verse 1]
戲台的燈一盞盞暗了
觀眾席空得像退潮
我還穿著那身水袖
沒有人叫我卸妝

[Pre-Chorus]
鑼鼓停了 我的心還在走板

[Chorus]
梨園未散 是我不肯下台
唱了一輩子別人的悲歡
輪到自己 卻沒有詞
只剩一個轉身的身段

[Verse 2]
師父說戲比天大
我信了四十年
如今天塌下來
也沒人看見

[Erhu Solo]

[Bridge]
若有來世還學這行
我想演一次不用哭的角

[Chorus]
梨園未散 是我不肯下台
唱了一輩子別人的悲歡
輪到自己 卻沒有詞
只剩一個轉身的身段

[Outro]
燈全暗了
我才謝幕
